insights: Pinch the slab across two flat opposite faces (yaw aligned with its edges, not across the corners) and wait for the grasp point before closing.

The red cube lies on its side with its long 11 cm axis running left-right; pinch it from above across its narrow 4 cm width, pads closing front to back, near its middle, and wait for the grasp point before closing.
The cube lies on its side with its long axis running left-right; the pads must close front to back across its narrow 4 cm width, gripping its right half; wait for the grasp point before closing.

Do not use the waist; the red cube lies on its side with its 11 cm long axis running diagonally from front-left to back-right (about 58 deg from straight ahead), so turn the hand so the pads close across its narrow 4 cm width (pads facing about -30 deg / +150 deg), descend from above onto its middle and close at the grasp point.
Keep the waist still; the cube lies diagonally (long axis ~58 deg from ahead): pinch across its 4 cm width, not along its length.
Take yaw +60 (or +45): the cube lies diagonally, so only that yaw pinches across its 4 cm width; close at the grasp point.
Elevation 45, yaw -45 (or -60): that pinches across the diagonal cube's 4 cm width; close at the grasp point.
Steeper is better here: elevation 60 deg, fingers well down over the flat-lying cube.
Pinch across the long axis: the jaws must close over the cube's 4 cm width; close at the grasp point.
Lift slowly and keep the grip.

start_contact and grown_to_n when it grew: perceive again, the scene is not as it was perceived), pushed = the hand itself pushed the bound object (it moved while the hand touched it: diagnostics.displacement_m, force_n, where pads | hand), lost = the bound object is gone from where the camera sees it (detect_objects again and bind the id it lists with jev_modify bindings, or jev_stop), body = the robot's body moved so far that the motion's goal no longer lies where the arm's rows go and re-planning from here did not take it (diagnostics.moved_m, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, goal_row_error_m, goal_shortfall_m), off_goal = the jaws did not close: the hand stands off the object's grasp point (diagnostics.error_m, error_hand_m), blocked = the object stopped the hand before the grasp (diagnostics.part, force_n, pad_above_top_m), stalled = the hand stayed stopped behind its plan and the arm now holds where it stands, its push released (diagnostics.tracking_error_m, since_s, contact, goal_shortfall_m).
